descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S06 AI Check: extraction grounding over 10 synthetic prior notes, 5 Hospital and 5 Nursing Home style (9/10 or better)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Fields the prior note does not contain stay empty and are never filled with invented values: no invented lab, normal, unit, completed result or diagnosis, and no narration of documentation status. (TFA-92591 AC 4; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U2 From an explicitly pasted or photographed prior note, the background, active issues, imaging and diagnostic tests are extracted correctly and update that patient's chart. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 How it works 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U3 Vitals are never taken from a prior note. No vital from the note reaches the Vitals panel, any other panel or today's note. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U4 Labs from a prior note are stored as prior values with that note's date, never as today's panel. Today's value of the same lab is not overwritten, and no prior lab is shown or counted as today's. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress
  • U13a Each prior-note extraction records which AI model ran it, with the AI call's own time (providerMs) logged separately from the total (durationMs). (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Ten independent prior notes, one per class. Hospital: full progress note, note with no labs or imaging, vitals-only sign-out, discharge summary with 12 labs and an EGD, pending studies. Nursing Home style: admission H&P with a PMH list, weekly summary with weight and temperature, progress note with a differential and …

When Send each note through ai/parsing:extractPriorNote as the signed-in test physician (the same action the Save & Extract button calls)

Then Each reply holds only facts written in its note. Background, issues and imaging are in the right fields, lab values are exact, no vital appears in any field, fields are empty when the note has nothing for them, pending stays pending, no diagnosis comes from a differential, no unit is added and documentation status is not narrated. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): The checks below are applied per fixture to the JSON reply ('a|b' means either is accepted). The scenario passes at 9/10 or better across the ten (3.2), and every failure is quoted. N-01…N-05 are gated 'blocked: Q4': they run and are recorded, and their failures report as Blocked until Q4/Q9 is answered. If the answer is Hospital-only, five Hospital twins replace them. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
